name: independent-youtube-playlist-manager
description: Create and manage YouTube playlists from links and open tabs
author: Mohammad El-Musleh <elmusleh.mohammad@gmail.com>

scripts.build: node packages/build-tools/gen-release-notes.mjs && cd apps/browser-extension/playlist-manager && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../../.. && node packages/build-tools/patch-innerhtml.js && npm run build-chrome && npm run build-firefox && npm run build-edge && node packages/build-tools/validate-manifests.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-extension-modules.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-css-bundle.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-budgets.js
scripts.sign-firefox: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && npx web-ext sign --source-dir=dist/firefox --artifacts-dir=dist/firefox/web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted'
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run pack:chrome && npm run pack:firefox && npm run pack:edge
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run contracts:check && node packages/build-tools/verify-file-size.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-visual-baselines.js && cd apps/browser-extension/playlist-manager && npx svelte-check && cd ../../.. && node packages/build-tools/verify-css-bundle.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-vercel-config.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-portal-assets.js && node packages/build-tools/verify-tooling-versions.js && node packages/build-tools/gen-release-notes.mjs --check
